object.attr: derived: a plain write leaves a truncated file over an issued PDF after a cancel, the time limit, a kill or a crash (CF-P59, CF-P4, CF-P8; D-P24; review Q10). A temporary file beside the output path is allowed, so the replace can be atomic (review Q25); a replace leaves another hard link to the old file as it was. MELLON-STORE-SRS-167 states the same for each file write; whether it covers the exported PDF is handed to STORE. Confirm against 0.3.0; set Implemented if 0.3.0 does this (review Q46).
object.description: If an export ends, or Mellon stops, without writing the whole exported PDF, Mellon shall leave the output path as before the export: the same file, or no file.
